maya: Hey folks — urgent ask. I need to duck out Sun 18:00-22:00 PT for a family thing. Can someone cover that window? I'm on PTO for the latter half of the day so I can't do a full handoff in person.

maya: Quick handoff notes below (tl;dr: no active incidents, watch the canary rollout + cache warmup). I'll DM creds for the incident Slack channel.

maya: Runbook highlights — please skim: 
• Canary model rollout started Sat 02:00 PT, version rw-v1-canary-2026. Keep an eye on latency spikes and model mismatch alerts.
• There's a scheduled batcher job at 19:15 to warm batch pools on ded. Might temporarily increase tail latency.
• Two low-priority tickets in the queue I started: #4327 (embed mismatch) and #4331 (slow kv-cache miss rate).

maya: Quick commands if you need a health snapshot:
```
# check oncall status
redwood oncall status --service inference

# quick tail of runtime logs
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=inference --tail=200
```

trent: I can take 18:00-20:30 and then ping olivia to finish 20:30-22:00. Is that split ok? :+1:

maya: Perfect, thanks @trent. I will note that the batcher warmup runs at 19:15 so either handoff needs to watch the 19:10-19:30 window for latency regressions.

olivia: I can grab the 20:30-22:00 slice. FYI I won't be able to debug deep GPU issues from phone but can coordinate escalations and trigger the fallback model if needed.

sam: If you end up needing me at night I can be on-call backup from 21:30-23:00. Also happy to pair with olivia on the handover at 20:30.

oncall-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance window on ded-gpu-3 at Sun 03:00 PT already completed. No open alerts.

trent: Quick note about the canary — metrics dashboard link: https://console.redwood/dev/dashboards/canary-rw-v1 (watch error_rate and median_latency). If error_rate > 1.5% for 10m, consider rollback flag.

olivia: Copy. Also leaving a short checklist for whoever takes over: 
• Confirm canary metrics stable (error_rate < 1.5%, median latency within 95th pct)
• Watch autoscaler logs for any OOM events
• If KV miss spikes, run cache-warmup script below once to warm hot prefixes

olivia: Cache warmup snippet (run from bastion):
```
for i in $(seq 1 40); do 
  curl -s -X POST 'https://api.redwood.prod/generate?model=rw-v1' -d '{"prompt":"warmup","max_tokens":1}' >/dev/null
  sleep 0.8
done
```

maya: Thanks all. I'll add a brief comment on the two tickets and set them to 'needs-review' so they don't get bounced.

sam: noted. I'll be reachable on phone if the rollback is needed. If anyone triggers rollback, please ping #eng-alerts and add a short note with reasons so we can correlate with perf tests.

maya: Leaving a final quick risk note: latency is slightly elevated in us-west-2 after the Saturday infra patch — not critical but be ready to flip routing to eu-west failover for affected customers if it crosses SLA thresholds.

trent: Got it. I'll do the first handoff and drop a short message in this thread at 20:25 UTC-7 confirming the swap.

maya: Really appreciate it — leaving now. Thanks for covering. :heart:
